behavior.name: RSN Handover Demo
behavior.author: huitao
behavior.description: FlexBE behavior for the RSN voice-guided xArm/ZED handover demo with basic recovery paths.

param.name: service_timeout_sec
param.label: Service timeout
param.hint: Timeout for normal Trigger service calls. MoveIt PTP/LIN at vel_scaling=0.1 takes ~13-16s per segment, so this must be >> that.

param.name: xarm_velocity_scaling
param.label: xArm velocity scaling
param.hint: MoveIt velocity scaling in (0, 1]. 1.0 = max joint speed; 0.1 = 10%.

param.name: xarm_acceleration_scaling
param.label: xArm acceleration scaling
param.hint: MoveIt acceleration scaling in (0, 1]. 1.0 = max joint acceleration; 0.1 = 10%.

param.name: xarm_param_service
param.label: xArm parameter service
param.hint: ROS parameter service used to set xArm motion parameters.

param.name: voice_timeout_sec
param.label: Voice timeout
param.hint: Maximum time to wait for a voice target.

param.name: instrument_detection_timeout_sec
param.label: Instrument detection timeout
param.hint: Maximum time to wait for instrument detection to publish a grasp pose.

param.name: wait_for_release_timeout_sec
param.label: Release timeout
param.hint: Maximum time to block on wait_for_release.

param.name: instrument_node_exit_delay_sec
param.label: Instrument exit delay
param.hint: Delay before starting hand detection to let instrument detection release the camera.

param.name: instrument_x_offset_m
param.label: Instrument x_offset_m
param.hint: Residual camera->base x offset (meters) applied to grasp pose. Pushed to /instrument_detection_node/set_parameters at behavior start.

param.name: instrument_param_service
param.label: Instrument parameter service
param.hint: ROS parameter service used to set instrument detection parameters.

param.name: query_prediction_timeout_sec
param.label: Query prediction timeout
param.hint: Max wait for the first WorkflowState message. On timeout the SM falls back to plain Return To P0 (estimator not running).

param.name: preload_detection_timeout_sec
param.label: Preload detection timeout
param.hint: Short timeout for the preload YOLO pass. If the predicted tool isn't visible quickly, fall back to Return To P0 so voice can be heard again.
